description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Irvine)] and [Fire Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Irvine)
description.text: Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x1.50/x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 and 5%/10%/15%/20% additional critical damage for equipped Fire abilities after casting 1/2/3/4+ Fire abilities

description.name: Dual Awoken Fire Mode II (Irvine)

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3
